notes: Ludum Dare 40 physics driving game Santa's Delivery Service (itch: https://bizbud.itch.io/santas-delivery-service). Complete Unity 2017.2.0f3 project; README last tested on 2017.4.1f1. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE.txt (Copyright 2020 Hayden Donnelly, Peter Prickarz, Eric Goetz; git blob 08715366a8dd0c261d12316a50667ce1f781a99e). Playable scenes enabled in EditorBuildSettings: Assets/Scenes/MainMenu.unity, Assets/Scenes/Levels/Level01.unity, Level02.unity, Level03.unity, and Level04.unity. No Packages/manifest beyond an empty UnityPackageManager/manifest.json; no TextMesh Pro / EmojiOne / DOTween / Asset Store / Library / Logs / DLL. Upstream tracks images/audio/models/fonts via Git LFS; those objects were pulled and stored as regular git blobs, and filter=lfs rules were removed from src/.gitattributes. Official Unity Post Processing Stack v1 is vendored under Assets/PostProcessing (Unity Technologies, BSD-3-Clause) with Christoph Peters bluenoise textures under CC0-1.0; NVIDIA FXAA 3.11 (FXAA.shader, FXAA3.cginc, FxaaComponent.cs, ARR) was omitted; WheelMovecs.FBX was an unresolved uppercase LFS pointer (not matched by *.fbx rules) and was omitted with its .meta. Assets/Fonts/Good Morning.ttf (imagex-fonts.com / IMAGEX, Version 1.00 August 30, 2017, name-table 'Free for personal use ONLY', md5 e12e3a71829ccbac262325062f827e96) was omitted with its .meta; referenced from MainMenu.unity and Prefabs/Essentials/Essentials.prefab (GUID refs may remain). Music retained under the repository MIT: Assets/Music/LD40_Soundtrack.wav (artist tag Eric, md5 e2f38aeec95eabf93e7bc1952e30d662) credited to composer Eric Goetz, and Assets/Music/Holy shit that scared me.wav (title That Scared Me, artist Hayden Donnelly, md5 0bfc8c0271a254b5364521372904fdf2). .DS_Store and .vscode were omitted. ~75M src snapshot.
